author: AgentForge Labs
description: A credential-safe Ruby client for the Telegram Notifier public v1 API. Supports source-scoped inbox, notification, reply and file flows with optional Bearer auth, idempotent writes, retries and structured errors.

author: Eric Jacobs
description: A dry-cli CLI for spaces: date-prefixed directories with a YAML identity file, $PWD-based current-space resolution, and XDG config/state. Provisions repos at copy-on-write speed from evergreen checkouts (pairs with repo-tender), concurrently on fibers. Ships fish shell integration and completions.

author: Visuality
description: Aggregates completed work across trackers into a unified per-user report. One set of organization credentials serves many users; the host application supplies configuration and ENV and receives a plain Hash, or a rendered console / Markdown / HTML report.

author: AgentForge Labs
description: A thin Ruby client for managed SnapForge with explicit self-hosted support, typed errors, safe retries, and credential redaction.
